收件复审 verdict (Director/skills seat, session `session_01MnijPVVDakqK2J335JoJtq`): **ACCEPT — 采纳原文,零改动**。⚠️ 本复审即认领时记录的档位出口补偿:派发走 opus(一句级机械治理面修订),补偿承诺「收件复审由本席以 fable 档执行」——已兑现,本会话即 fable,复审为实质逐行比对而非清单打勾。

Diff (PR #12890, one bullet, 13/13 at 470/470): the two funding cuts are both same-bullet restatements — the open qualifying list is superseded by the 判据 (不从任何包发布东西) + closed category list, with 「声明方式因仓库而异」 surviving through the 分流 header + the objectui half-sentence; the objectui trailing parenthetical was a restatement of the phantom argument already in the sentence, and the ⛔ prohibition itself is kept. All seven operative elements of the label-write protocol verified present in the new text (additive endpoint, dated 403 measurement, MCP fallback with union-diff comparative read-back, concurrent-strip re-add, size-labeler PUT wipe, read-back-not-write closes the step, phantom-gate caveat). The re-flow is not line-buying: funding is attributable to the cuts, count stays 13, and it retires a 169-byte quotation-exempt line on merit. Disclosure (b) accepted as disposed: the model-identifier trailer sits in an intermediate branch commit only; the repo disallows merge commits, so the squash landing takes the clean PR title/body and nothing reaches `main`.
